skills.title: Skills catalogue
skills.purpose: Every published skill, what it means at each level, who needs it now and in 2030, and how it maps to international frameworks.

skills-frameworks.title: International crosswalk
skills-frameworks.purpose: How Kafa'a skills map to ESCO, O*NET, SFIA 9, SkillsFuture, DigComp and other frameworks, with a machine-readable export.

skills-skill.title: Skill
skills-skill.purpose: Definition, level essence, roles now and in 2030, learning that builds it, crosswalk and sources.

admin-skills-alignments.title: Skills crosswalk editor
admin-skills-alignments.purpose: Add, edit, review and retire crosswalk rows. Framework owners edit; auditors read.

exact.label: Exact
exact.help: Same meaning and scope: the external entry and the Kafa'a skill can be used interchangeably.

close.label: Close
close.help: Nearly the same: small differences in scope or wording.

broad.label: Broad
broad.help: The external entry is wider: the Kafa'a skill is one part of it.

partial.label: Partial
partial.help: Overlap only: some of the Kafa'a skill is covered, some is not.

match.indicativeNote: A row stays "indicative" until a second framework owner reviews it. Codes are stored only when copied from the framework's own source; otherwise the row is label-level and the code is pending review.

review.indicativeHelp: Not yet reviewed by a framework owner: use as a guide only.

levels.caption: Kafa'a level to external level
levels.none: No level map: this framework has no proficiency levels.

export.valid: The export validates against the CASE-shaped schema: {items} items, {assoc} associations.

explorer.searchPh: e.g. data analysis, تحليل البيانات, systems thinking
explorer.obsoleteHidden: {n} obsolete skill hidden; it stays reachable by link:

mine.signIn: Sign in to see your level for this skill and keep it as a goal.
mine.notHeld: Not in your skills passport yet.
mine.goalNote: Goals are private to you. "Skills I want to grow" will build on them.
mine.securityNote: Security skills follow the security career path and are not personal goals.
mine.obsoleteNote: This skill is obsolete: add its replacement to your goals instead.

skill.noReplacement: No replacement: kept for the record.
skill.noDeployment: Awareness for planning only: no deployment decision implied.
skill.allFrameworks: See every framework and download the crosswalk
skill.ladder: What it means at each level
skill.ladderNote: The key level carries the skill's own essence line; the other levels use the generic level attributes shared by every skill (SFIA 9 style).
skill.noRoles: No published role profile asks for it at this horizon.
skill.rolesNote: From the published role profiles (FS05). 2030 and 2035 profiles are planning assumptions: no deployment decision or headcount implied.
skill.noLearningBody: Courses, pathways and credentials for future skills arrive in the next wave.

credVia.course: through a course that builds it

fw.intro: How each Kafa'a skill maps to international frameworks, so a profile, a course or a vacancy can be compared and exchanged. Codes are stored only when copied from the framework's own source; rows stay indicative until a second framework owner reviews them.
fw.tCoverageSub: {n} of {total} published skills have at least one alignment
fw.exportDesc: The published framework as a CASE-shaped package (1EdTech Competencies and Academic Standards Exchange) in the page language, and the crosswalk as CSV. Identifiers are stable between exports.
fw.registryDesc: Each framework, what Kafa'a uses from it, and how its codes and levels work.
fw.matrix: Coverage by framework and skill group
fw.matrixDesc: Skills with at least one published alignment, per framework and skill group.
fw.matrixNote: Cells show mapped skills out of the skills in that group; darker means more coverage.
fw.listDesc: Filter by framework, match type or review state.

admin.intro: Every crosswalk row with its status and review state. Framework owners add, edit, review and retire rows; every action is audited. Reviews follow maker-checker: never your own edit.
admin.readOnlyBody: Auditors read every row, including drafts and retired rows. Framework owners edit.
admin.reviewConsequence: The row stops showing "indicative" in English and Arabic. Your role and the date are recorded and audited.
admin.retireConsequence: It leaves the public crosswalk and the export, but is kept with your reason (never deleted).
admin.fCode: External code (only if copied from the source)
admin.codeHint: Format: {p}. Leave empty when you have not copied it.
admin.codeHintNone: Leave empty unless you copied the code from the source: the row then shows "code pending review".
admin.fArOfficial: The Arabic label comes from the framework itself
admin.fPublishHint: Unpublished rows stay drafts for framework owners.
admin.editNote: Saving an edit adds a version and makes the row indicative again until another framework owner reviews it.
admin.saveConsequence: The change is saved through the audited crosswalk RPC.

check.obsolete: This skill is obsolete: keep its existing alignments, but do not add new ones.
check.framework: Choose one of the listed frameworks.
check.label: Give the external label in English and Arabic (up to 200 characters each).
check.code: This code does not have the format the framework publishes. Leave it empty if you have not copied it from the source.
check.url: Cite the source with an https link.
check.as_of: Give the date you read the source (not in the future).
check.level_map: Each level-map entry takes up to 40 characters.
check.duplicate: This skill already has an active alignment to that framework entry.
check.immutable: The skill and framework of an alignment cannot change: retire it and add a new one.
